name: truth-or-lie
description: On-chain AI fact-verification betting game on GenLayer Studionet. Static HTML/JS frontend with a single Vercel serverless function (api/rpc.js) that proxies GenLayer RPC calls to avoid browser CORS restrictions. No build step, no framework — the previous package.json listed React/Vite/Tailwind/Google GenAI dependencies that are not actually used anywhere in this project.
